panels.title: Raft leader
panels.description: One lane per manager: green is the Raft leader, blue a follower. Exactly one lane should be green at any time; flapping lanes mean repeated elections. Green = leader, blue = follower.

targets.query: SELECT last("value") AS "v" FROM "dtfs_raft_is_leader" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)

panels.title: Has leader
panels.description: Minimum of raft_has_leader over the selected managers: YES while every manager sees a leader, NO as soon as one does not (election in progress or no quorum).

targets.query: SELECT min("value") AS "v" FROM "dtfs_raft_has_leader" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: Leader changes
panels.description: Leader changes seen over the selected time range (largest count among the selected managers). 0 is normal; a few mean restarts or elections, many mean an unstable cluster.

targets.query: SELECT max("s") AS "s" FROM (SELECT spread("value") AS "s" FROM "dtfs_raft_leader_changes" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY "node") WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Log fsync p99
panels.description: p99 of the Raft log append plus fsync (worst selected manager). Compare with Client write p99: if fsync is most of it, deferring the fsync would pay off.

targets.query: SELECT max("p99") AS "p99" FROM "dtfs_raft_log_write_us" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: Write p99
panels.description: p99 of a client_write on the local Raft, from proposal to applied (worst selected manager). This is the end-to-end cost of one metadata mutation.

targets.query: SELECT max("p99") AS "p99" FROM "dtfs_raft_client_write_us" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: Follower lag
panels.description: Largest follower lag in log entries across all peers, reported by the leader. Near 0 is normal; a growing value means a follower is slow, partitioned or down.

targets.query: SELECT max("value") AS "v" FROM "dtfs_raft_follower_lag" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: Raft log fsync vs client write, p50
panels.description: Median Raft log append plus fsync (orange) against the median end-to-end client write (blue), per manager. The gap is apply, replication and waiting; when the orange line is close to the blue one the fsync dominates a write.

targets.query: SELECT mean("p50") AS "p50" FROM "dtfs_raft_log_write_us" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)
SELECT mean("p50") AS "p50" FROM "dtfs_raft_client_write_us" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)

panels.title: Raft log fsync vs client write, p99
panels.description: Tail latency of the Raft log append plus fsync (orange) against the end-to-end client write (blue), per manager. p50 uses the mean of the per-interval p50, p99 the maximum of the per-interval p99. Spikes in orange that carry the blue line up point at disk fsync stalls.

targets.query: SELECT max("p99") AS "p99" FROM "dtfs_raft_log_write_us" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)
SELECT max("p99") AS "p99" FROM "dtfs_raft_client_write_us" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)

panels.title: Raft apply and vote write latency (p99)
panels.description: p99 time to apply one log entry to the state machine and to persist a vote, per manager. Apply should stay far below the client write latency; vote writes only happen during elections.

targets.query: SELECT max("p99") AS "p99" FROM "dtfs_raft_apply_us" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)
SELECT max("p99") AS "p99" FROM "dtfs_raft_vote_write_us" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)

panels.title: Entries per log append (p99)
panels.description: p99 number of log entries written per append, per manager. Higher values mean the leader batches many proposals into one fsync; always 1 means no batching.

targets.query: SELECT max("p99") AS "p99" FROM "dtfs_raft_append_entries" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)

panels.title: Bytes per log append (p99)
panels.description: p99 size of one Raft log append, per manager. Large appends take longer to write and fsync.

targets.query: SELECT max("p99") AS "p99" FROM "dtfs_raft_append_bytes" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)

panels.title: Apply lag per manager
panels.description: Last log index minus last applied index of each manager. 0 or a few entries is normal; a lag that keeps growing means the state machine cannot keep up.

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") AS "v" FROM "dtfs_raft_apply_lag" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)

panels.title: Follower lag by peer
panels.description: Leader's last log index minus the matched index of each follower. `peer` is the numeric Raft node id, not a hostname. A former leader keeps exporting 0 for its peers, so each line is the maximum over the selected managers. Near 0 is normal; a growing line is a slow or unreachable follower.

targets.query: SELECT max("value") AS "v" FROM "dtfs_raft_follower_lag" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "peer" fill(null)

panels.title: Millis since quorum ack
panels.description: Milliseconds since the leader last heard from a quorum (0 on non-leaders, so the maximum over managers is shown). Stays near the heartbeat interval; values reaching the election timeout predict a new election.

targets.query: SELECT max("value") AS "v" FROM "dtfs_raft_millis_since_quorum_ack" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: Raft term
panels.description: Current Raft term per manager. All managers share one term; a rising term means elections took place.

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") AS "v" FROM "dtfs_raft_current_term" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)

panels.title: Leader changes per minute
panels.description: Rate of leader changes seen by each manager. Zero is normal; bursts mean elections.

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1m) AS "r" FROM "dtfs_raft_leader_changes" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)

panels.title: gRPC requests by method
panels.description: Requests per second of each gRPC method, summed over the selected managers. Shows the mix of client, scheduler and Raft transport traffic.

targets.query: SELECT sum("r") AS "r" FROM (SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "r" FROM "dtfs_grpc_server_requests" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "method") WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "method" fill(null)

panels.title: gRPC latency by method (p99)
panels.description: p99 handler latency of each gRPC method, maximum over the selected managers. Long-polling or streaming methods are naturally slow; look for methods that got slower than usual.

targets.query: SELECT max("p99") AS "p99" FROM "dtfs_grpc_server_us" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "method" fill(null)

panels.title: gRPC errors by method and code
panels.description: gRPC calls that returned an error per second, by method and status code, summed over the selected managers. Normal is an empty graph or rare NotFound; sustained Unavailable or Internal needs attention.

targets.query: SELECT sum("r") AS "r" FROM (SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "r" FROM "dtfs_grpc_server_errors" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "method", "code") WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "method", "code" fill(null)

panels.title: gRPC in-flight calls
panels.description: Calls currently being handled, per method, summed over the selected managers. A value that stays high means handlers are blocked.

targets.query: SELECT max("value") AS "v" FROM "dtfs_grpc_server_inflight" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "method" fill(null)

panels.title: REST requests by route and status
panels.description: REST requests per second by route and status class, summed over the selected managers. 2xx is normal; 4xx and 5xx lines show failing callers.

targets.query: SELECT sum("r") AS "r" FROM (SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "r" FROM "dtfs_rest_requests" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "route", "status") WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "route", "status" fill(null)

panels.title: REST latency by route (p99)
panels.description: p99 REST handler latency per route, maximum over the selected managers. Dashboard and CLI polling routes should stay in the low milliseconds.

targets.query: SELECT max("p99") AS "p99" FROM "dtfs_rest_us" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "route" fill(null)

panels.title: Forwarding latency (p99)
panels.description: p99 of a write forwarded from a follower to the leader (forward), and of a write served locally or forwarded (write or forward), per manager. The forward line is the network plus leader cost followers pay on top of a local write.

targets.query: SELECT max("p99") AS "p99" FROM "dtfs_raft_forward_us" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)
SELECT max("p99") AS "p99" FROM "dtfs_raft_write_or_forward_us" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)

panels.title: Forwarding rates
panels.description: Writes forwarded by a follower (by request type), received by the leader, and failed forwards per second, per manager. Failed forwards should be zero; they appear during elections.

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "r" FROM "dtfs_raft_forwarded" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "op" fill(null)
SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "r" FROM "dtfs_raft_forward_received" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)
SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "r" FROM "dtfs_raft_forward_failed" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)

panels.title: Scheduler tasks created
panels.description: Repair, replication and anchor-lag tasks created per second by kind (leader only). Steady near zero when the cluster is healthy; bursts follow node loss or new writes.

targets.query: SELECT sum("r") AS "r" FROM (SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "r" FROM "dtfs_scheduler_tasks_created" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "kind") WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "kind" fill(null)

panels.title: Scheduler tasks finished
panels.description: Finished tasks per second by status. `done` should track created; any `failed` rate needs a look at the scheduler logs.

targets.query: SELECT sum("r") AS "r" FROM (SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "r" FROM "dtfs_scheduler_tasks_finished" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "status") WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "status" fill(null)

panels.title: Replication outcomes and repair budget hits
panels.description: Outcomes of replication scheduling per second, and how often the repair budget ran out. Occasional budget hits are normal during a large repair; permanent ones mean the budget is too small.

targets.query: SELECT sum("r") AS "r" FROM (SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "r" FROM "dtfs_scheduler_replication_outcomes" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "outcome") WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "outcome" fill(null)

SELECT sum("r") AS "r" FROM (SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "r" FROM "dtfs_scheduler_repair_budget_hits" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node") WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: Background task latency (p99)
panels.description: p99 duration of one scheduler, tiering, pre-cache, capacity-evict, retention and orphan-reap run (leader only, maximum over managers). Should stay well below the tick interval.

targets.query: SELECT max("p99") AS "p99" FROM "dtfs_scheduler_tick_us" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT max("p99") AS "p99" FROM "dtfs_tiering_tick_us" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT max("p99") AS "p99" FROM "dtfs_precache_tick_us" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT max("p99") AS "p99" FROM "dtfs_tiering_capacity_evict_tick_us" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT max("p99") AS "p99" FROM "dtfs_tiering_retention_tick_us" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT max("p99") AS "p99" FROM "dtfs_orphan_reap_us" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: Cache copies, fills and removals
panels.description: Cache copies scheduled by the promote and pre-cache planners (by target DC), fill-on-read registrations (by reader DC) and cache copies removed (by reason), per second. Shows how actively the cache is churning.

targets.query: SELECT sum("r") AS "r" FROM (SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "r" FROM "dtfs_tiering_promote_copies" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "target_dc") WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "target_dc" fill(null)

SELECT sum("r") AS "r" FROM (SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "r" FROM "dtfs_precache_copies" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "target_dc") WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "target_dc" fill(null)

SELECT sum("r") AS "r" FROM (SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "r" FROM "dtfs_cache_fill_commits" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "reader_dc") WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "reader_dc" fill(null)

SELECT sum("r") AS "r" FROM (SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "r" FROM "dtfs_cache_removed" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "reason") WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "reason" fill(null)

panels.title: Pre-cache and fill bytes
panels.description: Bytes per second scheduled by pre-cache and registered by fill-on-read. Compare with the WAN link budget; sustained peaks near the link speed starve other traffic.

targets.query: SELECT sum("r") AS "r" FROM (SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "r" FROM "dtfs_precache_scheduled_bytes" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node") WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT sum("r") AS "r" FROM (SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "r" FROM "dtfs_cache_fill_bytes" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "reader_dc") WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "reader_dc" fill(null)

panels.title: Orphan reap runs and chunks
panels.description: Orphan reap runs (by result), candidate chunks found and chunks removed per second. Zero most of the time; chunks should follow candidates after the grace period.

targets.query: SELECT sum("r") AS "r" FROM (SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "r" FROM "dtfs_orphan_reap_runs" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "result") WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "result" fill(null)

SELECT sum("r") AS "r" FROM (SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "r" FROM "dtfs_orphan_reap_candidates" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node") WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT sum("r") AS "r" FROM (SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "r" FROM "dtfs_orphan_reap_chunks" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node") WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: Orphan reap freed bytes
panels.description: Bytes freed per second by orphan reaping. Zero most of the time; bursts follow deleted files after the grace period.

targets.query: SELECT sum("r") AS "r" FROM (SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "r" FROM "dtfs_orphan_reap_freed_bytes" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node") WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: Files and nodes in the state machine
panels.description: Number of files and of registered nodes in the replicated state machine (every manager reports the same values; maximum shown). A sudden drop in files is a red flag.

targets.query: SELECT max("value") AS "v" FROM "dtfs_sm_files" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT max("value") AS "v" FROM "dtfs_sm_nodes" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: Nodes by health
panels.description: Registered nodes per health state. All nodes healthy is normal; suspect or down nodes start repair.

targets.query: SELECT max("value") AS "v" FROM "dtfs_sm_nodes_by_health" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "health" fill(null)

panels.title: Node health transitions per minute
panels.description: Node health transitions per minute by target state, summed over managers. Flapping nodes show up as repeated transitions.

targets.query: SELECT sum("r") AS "r" FROM (SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1m) AS "r" FROM "dtfs_monitor_node_transitions" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "to") WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "to" fill(null)

list.name: dc
list.label: DC
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "dtfs_raft_is_leader" WITH KEY = "dc"
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "dtfs_raft_is_leader" WITH KEY = "dc"

list.name: node
list.label: Node
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "dtfs_raft_is_leader" WITH KEY = "node" WHERE "dc" =~ /^$dc$/
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "dtfs_raft_is_leader" WITH KEY = "node" WHERE "dc" =~ /^$dc$/
